search_space: All 2,023 triples (C,m,x_k) in {0,...,16} × {0,...,6} × {-8,...,8}, in fixed lexicographic loop order C, then m, then x_k; every comparison was evaluated exactly using integers and math.isqrt.
witness_description: C=2, m=2, and x_k=2: x_k^2=4<2^m+C=6 and 2-sqrt(2)<1, but floor(sqrt(2))=1, so x_k<=floor(sqrt(C)) is false.
refutation_explanation: The inequalities 1<sqrt(2)<2 hold because 1<2<4. Hence 2-sqrt(2)<1, while floor(sqrt(2))=1. Thus this assignment satisfies both the stated antecedent and its stated intermediate consequence but violates the claimed bound.
